steps.what: Explore personal characteristics and home conditions through interviews and home visits
Evaluate applicants against child needs, observations and supporting evidence

tasks.design: Keep original observations and supporting documents available in the case system {OTHER} and {DOCS}. The worker evaluates the household and signs the assessment; a documentation tool does not establish applicant suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability depends on relationships, context and conflicting evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case access supports assessment without replacing visits or professional reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing persuasive accounts from sustainable care capacity and identifying risks to a particular child.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the household and explaining a fair, evidence-based assessment.
tasks.altitude: Assessment responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Child needs and the limits of applicant assessments

evidence.claim: The digest describes documentation support, not validated automated foster or adoption suitability assessment; this design claims no assessment saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers household evidence gathering and professional evaluation, not a separate application-processing or report-formatting task. Placement decisions are outside this task.
The worker produces observations and accounts in s1 with all55 hours retained. No machine consumes an assumed suitability score or structured home-condition flag.
Native case and document access come first; no new scoring system or custom build is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the assessment process and existing tools remain unchanged.
unknowns: National assessment requirements and final decision authority
Existing case evidence and assessment procedures
research_questions: Is report formatting a distinct measurable activity outside the evaluation itself?

already_counted.description: Evidence evaluation and final assessment responsibility

approvals.approved_version: Exact applicant assessment, supporting evidence and unresolved concerns; any change voids worker approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, gross0 and net0 after zero upkeep. Visits, interviewing and evaluation retain full time; no clerical fraction is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define social research questions, methods and ethical limits
Conduct research interviews or examine source material under the agreed protocol
Interpret social research evidence and qualify findings

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} for the protocol and source-linked findings, with {SPREADSHEET} calculations where the study requires them. Keep question selection, evidence gathering and interpretation human until a particular study exposes a repeatable transformation that can be measured separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Social research describes many methods rather than one repeatable processing operation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document and calculation tools support research, but their existing runtime is not a new saving.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling bias, participant trust, causal interpretation and evidence that contradicts the initial question.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing defensible methods and stating what the evidence cannot establish.
tasks.altitude: No new research authority or generic productivity claim.

reach.learn: Sampling, coding reliability and limitations of observational evidence

evidence.claim: Case-note drafting capabilities do not establish a saving for an unspecified social research method; zero is the provisional task scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is a small applied social research study from question through findings. Interviews and source examination are alternative evidence routes, not required methods in every study; no survey-entry baseline is assumed.
The worker produces the protocol in s1 and source-linked evidence in s2. No machine action depends on uncaptured structured responses, coding labels or consent flags.
Test native document and analysis functions first if a specific repeated operation is identified. No custom system is introduced here.
Zero additional upkeep because existing research practices remain; participant and research-lead labour are outside this denominator and unchanged.
unknowns: Research method, study scale and existing analysis tools
Participant access and applicable ethics review
research_questions: Which measured study operation is repetitive enough to change without reducing evidence gathering or interpretation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, net0 after zero incremental upkeep. Broad research scope supplies no measured clerical baseline to remove; existing calculations earn no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review case material and concerns raised by social workers before supervision
Supervise workers through reflective discussion, guidance and escalation decisions

tasks.design: Read original case information in the case system {OTHER} before supervision. Keep reflective dialogue, professional challenge and escalation decisions with the supervisor; scheduling or note drafting is not assumed to dominate this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful supervision depends on context and a relationship in which uncertainty can be raised.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case access helps preparation without replacing critical reading.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising blind spots, overload and concerns a worker has not yet articulated.
tasks.human_edge: Offering constructive challenge while retaining accountability and trust.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory responsibility and direct discussion remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish case-specific guidance from service capacity problems

evidence.claim: A case-note assistant does not replace professional supervision or establish a saving in reflective discussion.

assumptions: Boundary is case supervision preparation and dialogue, not staff rota administration or report production. The supervised worker's attendance is outside the focal supervisor denominator and unchanged.
No machine action consumes an assumed risk classification or readiness flag; original material is reviewed in s1 with full time retained.
Native access comes first. Zero upkeep because no new system, recording or supervision procedure is introduced.
unknowns: Whether administrative activities form a separate task
research_questions: What preparation helps challenge case assumptions without narrowing the supervision discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep. Reading and supervision keep full time; no scheduling or minutes baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Lead group counseling sessions, respond to distress and support safe participation

tasks.design: Keep the counselling session led by a qualified worker. Existing session materials in {DOCS} may support the group, but no automated facilitation, interpretation of distress or replacement of group contact is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support emerges through responsive conversation and safe interaction between participants.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital materials can support a session without replacing the worker's presence.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to grief, relapse concerns, silence, conflict and immediate distress.
tasks.human_edge: Building safety and adjusting the session to people in the room.
tasks.altitude: The worker continues to lead and take responsibility for the session.

evidence.claim: Documentation tools in the digest do not establish automated group counselling; direct session labour stays fully counted.

assumptions: Boundary is live group facilitation. Booking, individual treatment planning and later case notes belong to separate tasks; participant time is excluded and unchanged.
No machine consumes an assumed distress code or participant classification. The worker interprets live interaction with all session time retained.
Native materials remain available; no custom build, recording or new intervention is proposed. Zero incremental upkeep because the session process is unchanged.
unknowns: Group format, participant needs and escalation arrangements
research_questions: Which practical barriers to safe participation require human follow-up?

already_counted.description: Live facilitation and responses to participant needs

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, net0 after zero upkeep. No direct counselling time is removed and no separate paperwork saving is imported.
